_doc: Permanent self-test mutants (bead cq-w0-chk-selftest; CLAUDE.md 'The §6 checker', Self-test).
Each mutant is a CQ_spec reference lowered.ll with the listed edits applied in order, written under
$CQ_BUILD_DIR/mutants/<id>/ by checker/cqcheck/mutants.py. Each edit's 'old' must occur exactly once
in the text as it stands (with "all": true, at least once, every occurrence replaced). A mutant that
no longer applies after a re-pin is an error, never skipped.
'class' is a key of mutants.CLASSES, which gives the rejection the class predicts: the pattern some
reason of the reference check must match, and the one for the C-oracle check (or none when the
class is invisible to the C program, e.g. a kept rail).

mutants.note: rulings 2 A (cq-o9mx): the old s is not cleaned (its copy and free removed): no rule-6 clean is observed, so the carried s rails are no images and every trip leaves one live, a leak
rulings 2 A (cq-o9mx): a template result of the slot's load copy (quantum cell content) left live: no rule-6 clean reads it, so the leak rule still FAILS

edits.new:
%cqmutg = call i32 @cq_template_add_i32_hl(i32 %46, i32 1)
  %47 = call i32 @cq_template_add_i32(i32 %46, i32 %36)

mutants.note: rulings 2 A (cq-o9mx), rule 5: the slot's load copy, read by the rule-6 inverse, is not un-copied: a load copy is never a rule-6 image, so it is a leak
x > k ? x + a : x * b becomes x > k ? x * b : x + a: the measured result changes
b after the swap takes the other arm: the measured b changes (the rule 6 recomputation then also leaves dirt)
x == k becomes x != k, forward and uncompute alike: the phase fires on the complement
x > k becomes x <= k in both functions: the controlled Ry fires on the complement
the x < m rail is freed without its uncompute
the reverse loop frees x * a + b without uncomputing it
the comparison rail is freed twice

edits.old: call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)    ; IR: release the %7 rail (|0>)
edits.new:
call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)    ; IR: release the %7 rail (|0>)
  call void @cqrt_free(i32 %9)

mutants.note: the rotated register r is freed while live, then measured
the uncomputed comparison rail is never freed: an extra kept rail reading 0
rule 6's old counter rail (|0> after the copy; trip 0: the incoming 0) is never freed: extra kept rails reading 0
the clone's x * x rail is neither uncomputed nor freed: an entangled garbage rail live at exit, a leak by CR §6 item 1 (cq-tt2j); the sign rail stays a kept store's value
the controlled Ry takes the first rotation's angle
the closing Ry(-pi/2) is off by a few ulps
the nested phase takes the outer phase's angle
Ry on q2 controlled by q0 instead of q0 && q1
the in-loop controlled Ry on r is controlled by the previous trip's predicate
the else arm's Ry loses its NOT bracket: controlled by x > k instead of its negation
